summary: CBRE Global Real Estate Income Fund (NYSE: IGR) filed an 8-K disclosing implementation on September 4, 2026, of a 1-for-3 reverse stock split of its common shares, approved by the Board of Trustees alongside adviser CBRE Investment Management Listed Real Assets LLC. Every three shares convert into one; the monthly distribution rises from $0.06 to $0.18 per share, leaving shareholder cash flow unchanged. Trading continues on the NYSE under ticker IGR, effective on or about September 8, 2026. Structural note: proportional ownership and portfolio value are unaffected, with only fractional-share adjustments. What to watch: post-split liquidity, discount to NAV, and distribution sustainability.
